name: MFA-DVR
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering of MFA models
definition: The first direct volume rendering pipeline utilizing the Multivariate Functional Approximation (MFA) model, for both structured and unstructured volumetric datasets.
summary: MFA-DVR is a direct volume rendering pipeline using Multivariate Functional Approximation to provide compact, high-order evaluation for structured and unstructured data, outperforming local interpolation methods in speed and fidelity.
